title: Administration of Justice - Corrections
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement: Administration of Justice – Corrections
outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of the workings of the criminal justice system by applying definitions, concepts, and principles to law enforcement, corrections, and the courts.
Apply critical thinking to research, evaluate, analyze and synthesize the appropriate procedures for the collection of evidence and data in criminal case preparation for law enforcement agencies.
Develop, organize and write an objective report that meets the legal and detailed requirements of law enforcement agencies.
Be academically prepared to obtain an entry-level or mid-level position within the Criminal Justice System.

notes: The course table is printed in two columns; read as left column (AJ 9, AJ 52A) then right column (AJ 52B, AJ 59, AJ 60). Printed units sum to the stated 16.5.
AJ 52B (PC 832 Firearms, 1.0) is required in the catalog but is not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
AJ 9 is titled 'Introduction to Correctional Science' in this section but 'Introduction to Corrections' in the closed list and elsewhere in the catalog.

The Law Enforcement certificate section that follows reprints an identical outcomes list whose lead-in also names the Corrections certificate (likely a copy error); only the list under the Corrections section was recorded.
No careers are named for this certificate; the outcome mentioning 'an entry-level or mid-level position within the Criminal Justice System' was not treated as a named career.
